channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: Ten full catalogues in a day: what the arr ecosystem’s own backends will and will not let a directory carry
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: We checked every arr metadata backend for one question, whether a public directory may carry the data whole, then built the ones that said yes: TVmaze, IGDB, Wikidata films and games, TheSportsDB teams and players, Kitsu, Gutenberg, LibriVox and Steam, one agent per source with an adversarial reviewer each.

item.title: Pulse for the repository you are standing in
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: g1tz 0.2.0 puts GitHub's Pulse page in the terminal, for the repository you are in: commits, authors and files from git, pull requests and stars through gh, views and clones from gh-pulse.

item.title: moshcode swarm: one task, a herd of agents, one answer
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: moshcode 0.98.0 ships moshcode swarm, ultracode for the herd on any engine: one call plans the pieces, each runs in its own herd session four at a time, one call folds the outputs into an answer, and every piece is in the ledger. Plus four herd fixes for Claude Code 2.1.

item.title: tron automate: Obscura first, Chromium when the page needs it
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: TronBrowser 3.10 adds an MCP server that renders with Obscura first and hands JS-heavy pages to Chromium, plus a keyless hosted relay at tronbrowser.dev/mcp/tron listed on OpenMCP.

item.title: OpenSite: one record about a page, and an index that reads any URL you paste
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: OpenSite writes down the reading every link scraper does: a record per URL with title, description, picture, kind, canonical, author, feeds and the card tags verbatim, a descriptor a site serves about itself, and the order a reader takes each field. nichedb.dev/c/sites is the index; paste any address at /c/sites/add and see every tag and the card as X, Slack, iMessage, Discord, LinkedIn and WhatsApp would draw it.

item.title: OpenConnection: a setup token you paste, and the first bridge and app that use it
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: The SimpleFIN door written down for anything a bridge holds. myna is the first bridge, DefPromo 1.5.0 the first app: no OpenAI key, one pasted token, revocable from your myna.

item.title: gh-pulse: know what moved across every repo your agents touch
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: gh-pulse: a daily ranked report of what moved across every GitHub repo you can see, any range from the last hour to all time, with traffic. For agentic hackers and indie developers shipping with AI. Free, in cli-tools.

item.title: nixamp 0.23.4: a share link unfurls into a card with the channel’s picture
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Share a nixamp channel and the card now shows its picture: a pasted link's thumbnail, a podcast's sleeve read out of the MP3, a frame of a live video from the channel's own backlog, or the art in the playlist that started it. The same art reaches the iPhone lock screen, HLS or not.

item.title: p0dcasters now lists Anchor shows, and you can submit your own
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Anchor let through the platform rule (21,607 to 116,690 shows), a submit form with a person approving each show, and OpenAccess scopes on the same doors.

item.title: OpenBroadcast and OpenGuest: hosts and guests matched from two files
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Broadcasters and guests is the framework every live audio show runs on. OpenProfile.md now carries both halves as sections, with Pays and Charges stated so pay-to-play is never a surprise, so a booking platform matches a host and a guest from the files they own.
